$comment: Job schedules (01 §5.6, D-38). The deploy turns this into pg_cron jobs named familywise-<name> (scripts/job-schedules.mjs) and into private.job_schedule rows for job_health. Cron times are UTC. HTTP jobs call /api/jobs/<name in kebab-case> and each owns its minutes: no two HTTP jobs share a minute (schedule.test.ts). SQL jobs run inside the database.

jobs.name: heartbeat
jobs.purpose: Sample job: proves pg_cron, pg_net, the job endpoint and job_run end to end, and reports scheduling lag.

jobs.name: purge_history
jobs.purpose: Keeps history small: pg_cron run details 7 days, job_run 90 days, app_error 30 days.
jobs.sql: delete from cron.job_run_details where end_time < now() - interval '7 days'; delete from public.job_run where started_at < now() - interval '90 days'; delete from private.app_error where occurred_at < now() - interval '30 days';
